rows.Kwic: 僧問。如何是空劫已前自己。師曰。白馬入蘆華。官人問。有人修行否。
rows.sourceTitle: 筠州洞山悟本禪師語錄

Override.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dongshan Wuben of Junzhou (筠州洞山悟本禪師語錄), in Dongshan Liangjie's question-and-answer record. An unnamed monk is the exact questioner who asks, ‘what is oneself before the empty eon?’; Dongshan Liangjie answers, ‘a white horse enters the reed flowers.’ The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give the monk a personal name.
